findings.title: Native path interpretation can open a database outside the retained use lease
findings.contract: GuardedDatabase must retain exact physical-resource DatabaseUseLease for the full native handle lifetime.
findings.trigger: Call open_ladybug_database with a leading-tilde path. The lease interprets tilde as a literal directory, but lbug expands it before opening.
findings.evidence: Isolated Darwin public-API probe successfully queried RETURN 1 and RETURN 2 on the native database while its actual parent-family coordination file accepted exclusive fs2 ownership. The addressed literal database did not exist. The distinct actual and guarded parents are printed in tilde-probe.log. The probe exited0.
findings.consequence: A cleanup caller can obtain physical-family exclusivity over the database actually opened while the guarded native handle remains live; the new lifetime exclusion contract is therefore false.
findings.baseline_distinction: Native path expansion predates the patch. The introduced wrapper acquires exclusion for the untransformed input, so its newly promised lifetime protection is incomplete.
findings.remedy: Validate native path interpretation before acquisition and native open. Use the same supported, absolute, lossless, consistently normalized path for both lease and Database::new, or explicitly reject unsupported forms before side effects. Do not silently reinterpret a formerly expanded tilde as a different literal cwd/tilde database. Preserve raw Direct address-derived writer/journal keys and caller SystemConfig flags.
findings.verification: Add regressions for native path transforms and prove that the actual native physical-family lock cannot be obtained exclusively while a wrapper/connection is live; alternatively prove rejected forms fail before creating native files or coordination state.

native_path_trace.rust: src/database.rs::Database::new passes path.display().to_string() to native FFI.
native_path_trace.expansion: lbug-src/src/storage/storage_utils.cpp:72-107 preserves empty/:memory: mode, expands leading tilde, then makes relative paths absolute and lexically normalizes dot and dot-dot. Windows drive/UNC special handling avoids absolute where appropriate.
native_path_trace.cwd: Static interleaving: lease resolves a relative path, another thread changes process CWD, and the unchanged relative path passed to native is resolved again. No deterministic CWD-race probe was executed.
native_path_trace.symlink_dotdot: Static consideration: Rust canonicalize follows an intermediate symlink before dot-dot, whereas native lexically_normal cancels components before filesystem lookup. Absolute conversion alone does not address that distinction. No symlink/dot-dot native probe was executed.
native_path_trace.non_utf8: Static Linux consideration: lease validates UTF-8 basename but not all parent bytes; native display conversion may open a U+FFFD parent while the lease protects original bytes. The attempted Darwin raw-parent fixture failed at directory creation with EILSEQ; it does not establish native Linux qualification.
native_path_trace.memory_mode: Empty paths and :memory: are native in-memory modes; a correction must not silently convert these into on-disk resources.
